Overview

Baden bei Wien is a city in Lower Austria with a population of 26,286. A historic spa town south of Vienna, known for its thermal springs, Biedermeier architecture, the Beethoven House, and the beautiful Rose Garden. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
